why:

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1975, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1975 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general fund balance sheet (p53 `Revolving Funds`: School Lunch 24,123.42; School Athletics 518.80; Adult Education 54.31), the School Lunch program's own receipts and expenditures (p144) and the School Department's special accounts (p148-149); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched revolving and special revenue: the only hits are p53 and p144-149 (sources/data/report-tables/1975/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1975 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1975?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1975 report prints no such schedule: the balance sheet lists appropriation balances for individual projects (p53) and the accountant's schedule lists each article (p68-79), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project, capital plan and capital improvement: no capital plan is printed (sources/data/report-tables/1975/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1975 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1976?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1975 report prints the total assessed valuation of real estate and personal property and the tax rate in the `About the Town` list (p3, landed as NOT LANDED facts) and overlay reserved for abatements as a balance-sheet line (p54); no valuation by property class, no levy history, no new growth schedule. Searched valuation, overlay, levy, recapitulation, new growth across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1975/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' fiscal 1976 tax rate recapitulation.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1975, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1975 report prints the Inspector of Weights and Measures as a budget line (p42 `970.00`), a payment (p61 `841.50`) and a receipt (p59 `Sealing Fees 312.10`), and p27 mentions the office in prose; no device counts and no fee schedule. Searched sealer and weights and measures across the whole text, pages 27, 61, 72 (sources/data/report-tables/1975/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1975 annual report to the Town.
